guard: Manager.awaitHandleExit still invokes AgentHandle.waitForExit when status is already exited, so runtime cleanup runs for a late observer on any runtime kind
why: waitForExit is where seat closes the controller socket. Skipping it when status is already exited leaks that socket on the late-observer path. awaitHandleExit is generic over AgentHandle, so the cell uses a non-seat kind.

mutations.name: skip waitForExit once status is already exited
mutations.expectRed: late observer still invokes waitForExit after the child already reports exited
mutations.cell: late observer still invokes waitForExit after the child already reports exited
